shareLink.title: Share as an encrypted link
shareLink.intro: The note is encrypted on this device and travels inside the link. No server stores it or sees it: the part of the link after # is never sent anywhere. Whoever has the whole link can read the note; nobody else can.
shareLink.expiryNote: The viewer refuses the note after this date. The link itself still holds the note, so someone who kept it could decode it by hand.
shareLink.keyHint: Send the key another way (another app, in person). The link alone can't open the note.
shareLink.tooBig: This note is too large for a link ({chars} of {max} characters). Download it as an encrypted file and send the file together with this link, which holds only the key:
shareLink.unsupported: This browser can't encrypt or open share links (no WebCrypto or CompressionStream).
shareLink.view.badge: Shared note · read-only · decrypted on this device
shareLink.view.needKey: This link came without its key. Paste the key you received:
shareLink.view.needFile: Choose the encrypted file (.lumenshare) you received with this link:
shareLink.view.error.malformed: This link is damaged or incomplete. Ask for it again.
shareLink.view.error.key: This key doesn't open the note: the key is wrong, or the link was changed.
